segments.title: Cold Open with Pepito
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station sign-on as executive producer, identifying as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: Crum's Mayoral Reconstruction
segments.notes: Crum, as newly elected mayor of Rennerton, plays Valheim live: gathers resources, builds structures (fermenters, jet ski, treehouse), hunts, fights trolls/bears/skeletons, and manages town infrastructure while fending off constant wildlife attacks and lag.

segments.title: First Mayoral Press Conference
segments.notes: Crum fields questions from citizens on Goblin Pizza Hut's bid, molasses GPUs, Gooters chicken wetness, data centers, strip club vs family town, and allegations of gooning with trolls; Munch briefly interrupts.

segments.title: Second Press Conference & Election Lead-up
segments.notes: After dying and losing his jet ski, Crum holds another press conference addressing school quality, meth, skeletal civic rights, swamp drainage, and hell-door allegations; transitions to mayoral election.

segments.title: Mayoral Election & Raid
segments.notes: Melody Von Torture (MVT) wins mayoral race over Crum; Crum concedes and pledges advisory support; stream ends with raid to Harry Hardy.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold-open sign-on as the dog who produces the show.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: mayor of Rennerton / debate analyst. Serves as acting mayor of Rennerton for the full broadcast, running a live Valheim reconstruction session while fielding press conferences and an election.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly heard off-camera at 02:18:35 coordinating dinner (chicken in air fryer) with Crum during the stream.

characters.name: Melody Von Torture (MVT)
characters.notes: citizen / mayor-elect. Assists Crum in-game, runs for mayor, wins the election at stream's end, and becomes mayor-elect of Rennerton.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Nominated as a mayoral candidate (option 'Peter') but does not appear on-screen.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Referenced at 02:34:39 as present ('Chet is here actually') but does not speak on air.

storylines.beat: [2026-11-07] Crum serves as mayor for a full Valheim reconstruction session: builds fermenters (ball juice mead), jet ski (lost and rebuilt), treehouse on swamp island, discovers ancient bark for longship; MVT elected mayor at end.
[2026-11-07] Crum references being 'mandated by a court to get punched in the penis' during press conference at 01:10:02, confirming the storyline's place in Rennerton lore.

lore_notes.fact: Elected mayor of Rennerton prior to this broadcast (references 'duly elected mayor yesterday' at 09:07).
Establishes fermenters producing 'ball juice' mead (poison resistance, healing, stamina) as first drinkable beverage at Gooters.
Builds and loses first jet ski; constructs second jet ski after death.
Discovers ancient bark on swamp island, unlocking longship and bonfire recipes.
Wins mayoral election over Crum (97 votes to MVT's winning tally) at 02:35:47, becoming mayor-elect of Rennerton.
Appears off-camera via voice at 02:18:35 coordinating dinner with Crum, confirming her presence in the studio/house during the broadcast.

episode_summary: Executive producer Pepito opens the broadcast before Crum, newly elected mayor of Rennerton, commandeers the stream for a multi-hour live Valheim reconstruction session. Crum gathers resources, builds fermenters producing the town's first drinkable mead ('ball juice'), constructs and loses a jet ski, establishes a treehouse outpost on a swamp island, and survives relentless wildlife attacks. Two press conferences field citizen questions on infrastructure, skeletal rights, and swamp drainage. The broadcast concludes with a mayoral election in which Melody Von Torture unseats Crum, who pledges bipartisan advisory support before raiding Harry Hardy.
